name: pocket-large-g1
description: The pocket-large toolpath as a CAM program would send it: one straight move per path segment (13 moves of 4 to 90 mm) instead of 0.75 mm steps. The swept region is the same, so the exact volume must match pocket-large up to the rounding of the intermediate points to the 1 nm grid; for a Z-map preview it checks that a long step is evaluated as accurately as many short ones. See docs/gpu-findings.md.
